scripts.create:assets: mkdir -p assets/js && mkdir -p assets/scss && mkdir -p assets/css && mkdir -p assets/fonts && mkdir -p static/assets/fonts
scripts.copy:fontawesome: cp node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/css/all.min.css assets/css/fontawesome.all.min.css && cp -r node_modules/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/webfonts/* assets/fonts/ && sed -i 's|../webfonts/|/assets/fonts/|g' assets/css/fontawesome.all.min.css
scripts.copy:all: npm run create:assets && npm run copy:mermaid && npm run copy:popper && npm run copy:bootstrap-js && npm run copy:bootstrap-scss && npm run copy:lunr && npm run copy:fontawesome
scripts.rm:public: [ -d public ] && rm -Rf public; echo 'public directory removed or did not exist'
scripts.run:dev: npm run copy:all && npm run rm:public && hugo server
scripts.run:build: npm run copy:all && npm run rm:public && hugo && cd public && php -S localhost:1313
scripts.build: npm run copy:all && npm run rm:public && hugo --minify
